answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in forge, expire in plume, and vine lists each expiry. Someone running 136 aliases therefore needs 99 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1734 identities would post 4348 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
